title: Anonymous Message
description: Sarah received an anonymous message luring her to the meeting, but Michael denies sending it.

title: Michael's Lie
description: Michael claims he's never been to the building but recognizes a photograph of it.

title: Missing Key
description: A key is missing from Sarah's apartment. Someone who knew about it took it.

title: Hidden Photograph
description: A photograph was deliberately hidden behind a cabinet in the basement.

title: Father's Connection
description: The building in the photograph is connected to Sarah's father, who worked there.

title: Active Signal
description: The radio signal is still active, suggesting someone else is in the building.
